description:
Confirm the email with the 6-digit code, or check whether the email link was clicked.

        Preferred: confirm_signup(account_id, code, signup_token). The first confirmation returns api_key; store it, it is shown once.
        Link clicked instead: call confirm_signup(account_id, signup_token) every 5 seconds, up to 10 minutes, until email_verified is true, then call create_api_key.
        A code allows 5 attempts and lasts 24 hours. For a new code, call resend_code(email).

anyOf.description: account_id returned by signup, not a pixel ID

account_id.description: account_id returned by signup_free. Use with code, or with signup_token alone to check whether the email link was clicked. Example: 3f1c2b9e-1d2a-4c5b-9e8f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
account_id.title: Account Id

code.description: The 6-digit code from the AgentPixel email. Ask the person to read it to you. Example: 482913
code.title: Code

anyOf.description: Private token returned by signup or confirmation link; never publish it

signup_token.description: signup_token returned by signup_free. With code, the first confirmation also returns the API key. Alone with account_id, returns whether the email is confirmed.
signup_token.title: Signup Token

anyOf.description: Private token returned by signup or confirmation link; never publish it

verification_token.description: Older method: the token value from the confirmation link URL (?token=...). Prefer account_id and code.
verification_token.title: Verification Token

name: confirm_signup
title: Confirm signup email
